<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple hero (model hero@1): an optional badge, the heading, a description, up to two links as the actions
  (links styled as buttons, the first primary, the second secondary: each drawn only when its label and its
  address are both set) and one picture. Axes: media (end: the picture after the copy, start: before it, top:
  above it, wide), frame (box: inside the container; split: two halves, the picture to the edge of the screen).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type HeroSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  badge?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt?: string;
  imageDark?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  secondaryActionLabel?: string;
  secondaryActionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "end" | "start" | "top";
  frame?: "box" | "split";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  badge = "",
  title,
  description = "",
  image,
  imageAlt,
  imageDark,
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  secondaryActionLabel = "",
  secondaryActionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "end",
  frame = "box",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<HeroSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const edge = computed(() => ((frame as string) === "split") && ((media as string) !== "top"));
const pad = computed(() =>
  (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
  : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
  : "py-16 lg:py-32"
);
const copyPad = computed(() =>
  edge.value ? cn("justify-center px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-16", pad.value)
  : ""
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="(edge ? '' : pad)"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="hero-simple"
  >
    <Container :class="(edge ? 'w-full' : 'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4')">
      <Box
        :class="cn(
          'grid grid-cols-1',
          (edge ? '' : 'gap-8'),
          (((media as string) === 'top') ? '' : (edge ? 'md:grid-cols-2' : 'items-center md:grid-cols-2'))
        )"
      >
        <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) !== 'end')"
          :alt="(imageAlt ? imageAlt : title)"
          :src="image"
          :darkSrc="imageDark"
          :ratio="(((media as string) === 'top') ? '21/9' : '4/3')"
          :class="(edge ? 'md:aspect-auto md:h-full' : '')"
        />
        <Stack gap="6" :align="column" :class="copyPad">
          <Badge v-if="badge" variant="secondary">
            {{ badge }}
          </Badge>
          <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="lg" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <Group
            v-if="((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))"
            gap="4"
            align="center"
            :justify="column"
            class="flex-wrap"
          >
            <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
              {{ actionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
            <LinkButton
              v-if="(secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)"
              variant="secondary"
              size="lg"
              :href="urlOf(secondaryActionHref)"
            >
              {{ secondaryActionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
        <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'end')"
          :alt="(imageAlt ? imageAlt : title)"
          :src="image"
          :darkSrc="imageDark"
          ratio="4/3"
          :class="(edge ? 'md:aspect-auto md:h-full' : '')"
        />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
